psychological_meaning: Camouflage Green evokes feelings of nature, stealth, and practicality. It is often associated with the military and survival, conveying a sense of being grounded and adaptable. This color can also represent environmental awareness and a desire for harmony with nature.

real_world_examples.title: Military Uniform
real_world_examples.description: Camouflage Green is commonly used in military uniforms to provide concealment in natural environments.

real_world_examples.title: Forest Landscape
real_world_examples.description: The color of lush forest foliage, representing growth and renewal.
